$comment: One source of truth for the hosted checkout the E2E suites drive, in both PAYMOB_MODE=fake and PAYMOB_MODE=sandbox. The Paymob fake (apps/backend/test/fakes/paymob-server.ts) renders its card form from `labels` and settles each payment by looking the submitted card up in `cards`. The Maestro subflow (apps/mobile/e2e/flows/_pay-checkout.yaml) and the Playwright driver (checkout-driver.mjs) type and tap by the same `labels`. So the fake behaves as Paymob does, and a flow cannot tell which one it is on. Once real test keys are in place, open a sandbox checkout once and copy Paymob's visible field labels into `labels`. The fake then follows on its own.
